speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative C. diff tests and lack of blood in the stool, your symptoms are likely antibiotic-associated diarrhea secondary to levofloxacin use. I recommend discontinuing the antibiotic if clinically feasible and initiating supportive care with oral rehydration and probiotics.
